Vendored from https://github.com/raktim-mondol/academic-harness
Commit: dbc7414662c776b55e9da87c798d1ad08bf1c941
Version: 0.1.0 (rubric 1.2.0)

Note (2026-10-23): the upstream engine repository is no longer available at this
URL; the name now refers to this DSH plugin. The vendored tree and this pin are
authoritative for the engine; see docs/ACADEMIC-HARNESS-ENGINE.md.

Python engine only (`ah/` package + pyproject.toml). The Pi adapter
(`packages/ah-pi/`), Claude Code adapter, examples, phase reports, golden
sets, tests, and `vendor/pi/` were not copied. The engine stays inside this
plugin; a local `.venv` is created next to this tree. Nothing is installed
into `$DSH_HOME`. ResearchCraft drives it through native DSH tools and
interceptors (`academic-harness.js`, `academic-harness-hooks.js`).

An optional T3 verifier backend in `ah/verifier/backends.py` can shell out
to a `pi` binary when a project sets `verifier.backend: pi`. That is unused
unless the project asks for it; `http` (OpenAI-compatible) and `command`
backends work without Pi.

Python package unmodified.

Local DSH patch (ahead of upstream): registry --keys citation-key aliases
(entry_for consulted by resolve/resolve_all/BIB-02) and byte-copy of .md/.txt
sources so AH copies stay byte-identical to the sender's raw document.
